Name: Kenneth's Vegetable Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Adds a new constructible building - Kenneth's Vegetable Shop (built by Robin) - with 172 custom vegetables to buy![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Customization: By default, all vegetable items appear in the shop. If you prefer a smaller selection and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual vegetables to remove them from the shop. Re-enabling a vegetable restores it to the shop.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]AI Disclosure: Only the shop building artwork included in this mod was generated using AI tools to make it more accurate as a real shop. Other assets, including shop items, food sprites, and in-game portraits, were sourced separately and are still non-AI and hand-sourced. The mod's code, implementation, and technical integration were created by me. Gameplay is the same, only the building looks better.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Shop building preview is in-game only and not shown in mod images - only visible after installing the shop mod.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A Note to My Players: Advance apology to those who have downloaded my shop mods and are not a fan of AI art. I completely understand and respect your preference.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The old building style is still available and usable. I will upload it to a separate mod page as a building replacer - this means it will only replace the building look, so you will still need my original shop mod for it to work.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Thank you for supporting my mods!❤️[/b][/size]
